prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: ONE standalone portrait A4-proportioned front-cover concept for an English Primary 1 mathematics textbook, flat artwork, no physical book mockup.
Reference image: supplied local character sheet is the identity and illustration-style reference, NOT a layout to reproduce. Preserve all four children's faces, skin tones and clothing.
Title text verbatim: "Maths with Friends"
Subtitle verbatim: "Count. Explore. Discover."
Labels verbatim: "Primary 1" and "Textbook", separated by a centred dot if on one line.
Make all lettering beautifully clear and correctly spelled, large confident friendly typography. Spacious top title zone, generous breathing room. No other text, author name, publisher logo or endorsement.
Picture: Aishatu, Adamu, Grace and John sorting a few clearly drawn maize cobs into two simple woven baskets at a reachable wooden activity table. Clear warm yellow maize kernels, tapered cobs, small green husks; objects well separated, easy to recognise. This is decorative cover art, not a counted exercise. Exactly four children, all actively and equally participating. Aishatu mustard hijab covering all hair/neck/shoulders, long-sleeved teal ankle-length dress. Adamu cropped black hair, blue collared short-sleeved shirt, clay-orange shorts. Grace neat close-to-scalp ALL-BACK cornrow plaits with tucked ends, clay-orange blouse and green skirt. John completely smooth shaved head with NO hair or stubble, green shirt and ochre trousers, seated naturally in his blue manual wheelchair with visible large rear wheels, push rims, small front casters and foot support. Show John's wheelchair clearly and keep all of it in frame. Table has open knee clearance, no crossbar across his access, comfortably reachable surface; John independently places a cob in a nearby basket. Other three stand around accessible sides. No floating objects or malformed hands. Keep full figures within the image.
Style: bright warm polished children's gouache picture-book illustration consistent with reference. Simple warm-cream background with just a quiet suggestion of green foliage and ground; familiar objects and established friends evoke Gombe without invented landmarks. Leaf green, sunny yellow and warm cream, small blue accents. Clear uncluttered composition, scene in lower two-thirds, title upper third. Cheerful lively collaboration, natural expressions, restrained background, no extra people, no numerals, equations, flags, extra decorative school objects or watermarks.
inspection: Readable title, subtitle and Primary 1 · Textbook labels. Four children retain established clothing, Grace's cornrows and John's shaved head and blue wheelchair. All four sort recognisable maize into baskets at a reachable table. Decorative quantities only. Neither book modified.
